meta.name: diffdock
meta.description: DiffDock and DiffDock-L molecular docking. Use for protein-small-molecule pose prediction from PDB or sequence plus SMILES/SDF/MOL2, batch docking, virtual screening, and pose-confidence interpretation. Not for binding affinity prediction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测蛋白质与小分子的结合姿态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要预测蛋白质和小分子复合物的三维结构
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to predict 3D structures of protein-small molecule complexes

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会利用 DiffDock 进行分子对接：预测小分子与蛋白质的结合构象，支持 PDB 文件或氨基酸序列输入，批量处理虚拟筛选，并输出置信度分数。不预测结合亲和力。
howto.when: 当你要求分子对接、预测结合姿势、虚拟筛选，或提供 PDB 文件与 SMILES/SDF/MOL2 等配体描述时触发。

say.text: 运行批量虚拟筛选，提前计算 ESM 嵌入以加速。
say.note: 使用预计算嵌入高效处理大批量复合物。

say.text: 分析 batch 结果，按置信度排序并导出 CSV。
say.note: 运行 analyze_results.py 生成统计摘要。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude uses DiffDock to perform molecular docking: predict 3D binding poses of small-molecule ligands to protein targets from PDB files or amino acid sequences, support batch virtual screening, and output confidence scores. Not for binding affinity prediction.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for molecular docking, pose prediction, virtual screening, or provide PDB files and ligand descriptions (SMILES/SDF/MOL2).

say_en.text: Use DiffDock to dock this ligand SMILES to the protein PDB, output top 3 poses.
say_en.note: Runs single docking, returns top-ranked conformations.

say_en.text: Run batch virtual screening with precomputed ESM embeddings for speed.
say_en.note: Uses precomputed embeddings for efficient large-batch processing.

say_en.text: Analyze batch results, sort by confidence, and export to CSV.
say_en.note: Runs analyze_results.py to generate statistical summaries.
